project.name: bot-pilot-google-calendar-connector-infrastructure-vault
project.description:
Infrastructure adapter: Spring Cloud Vault integration.
Provides dynamic database credentials via Vault's Database secrets engine. Authenticates using AppRole (role-id from env, secret-id from file at /run/secrets/bot-connectors-secret-id — matching the Python config.py pattern).
Vault role: bot-connectors-calendar-role (same as Python DatabaseConnector).
Why Spring Cloud Vault instead of a direct hvac equivalent? Spring Cloud Vault integrates with Spring's Environment abstraction, meaning dynamic DB credentials from Vault are automatically injected into DataSource configuration without manual credential refresh plumbing. The Python code had to manage token expiry and refresh manually; Spring Cloud Vault handles this.
This module contains only the bootstrap/configuration class; no domain logic.
